items.text:
Took some time to really think about what I wanted to write here. I really loved the game, its genre and style are fantastic. Conceptually its exactly the type of game that I have always wanted to play and experience. That said its got so many glaring issues that its basically impossibly hard to recommend even on sale. 

The approachability for new and returning players is really not there. Nerfs and design changes throughout the 1.0 launch have crippled the new player experience. One key issue is related to a piece of gear that is basically the go to tool of a starting ship breaker being removed or made to rare that is doesn't exist in the early game zones. The laser welder/torch should be part of the standard available kit and yet it was reduced and removed from the starting station. This could be forgiven but the backpacks and other tools were also changed for location making starting a chore. If the base AI was able to swap tools and charge batteries on their own it would almost be forgivable but they can barely eat unsupervised.  

The AI leaves so much to be desired. It lacks any true level of autonomy even after six years that its hard to even call it AI. Watching NPC stations as the AI has meltdowns and drops tools to rush aboard ships to watch tv is funny the first time and deeply sad the hundredth. 

The game used to be about fun ship building and breaking, now its aa chore and 1.0 cause "idk feels done" was basically the devs answer.
items.text_zh:
花了一些时间认真思考我想在这里写些什么。我真的很喜欢这款游戏，它的类型和风格都很棒。从概念上讲，它正是我一直想玩和体验的那种游戏。话虽如此，它有很多非常明显的问题，以至于即使打折也基本上很难推荐。

对新玩家和回归玩家的易上手性真的不存在。整个1.0发布期间的削弱和设计改动严重损害了新玩家的体验。一个关键问题与一件装备有关，它基本上是新手拆船工的必备工具，却被移除或变得极其稀有，以至于在早期游戏区域根本不存在。激光焊枪/焊炬本应是标准可用工具包的一部分，但它被削减并从起始空间站移除了。这还可以原谅，但背包和其他工具的位置也被改变了，让开局变成了一件苦差事。如果基础AI能够自己更换工具和给电池充电，那几乎还可以原谅，但它们连无人监督地吃饭都勉强。

AI有太多不足之处。即使过了六年，它也缺乏任何真正程度的自主性，以至于很难称之为AI。看着NPC空间站里AI崩溃、丢下工具冲上飞船去看电视，第一次看很有趣，第一百次看则令人深感悲哀。

这款游戏曾经是关于有趣的造船和拆船的，现在却成了一项苦差事，而1.0是因为“不知道，感觉做完了”基本上就是开发者的回答。
